description: This file is a header file for editor-related functions in a Git-related project. It declares functions for launching editors, editing buffers interactively, and querying terminal properties.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Returns the command for the user preferred editor.

methods.name: git_sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the command for sequence editor.

methods.name: is_terminal_dumb
methods.description: Checks if the terminal is a dumb terminal.

methods.name: launch_editor
methods.description: Launches an editor to edit a file, filling the buffer with the file's contents after editing.

methods.name: launch_sequence_editor
methods.description: Launches a sequence editor for the specified file.

methods.name: strbuf_edit_interactively
methods.description: Writes out, clears, launches editor, reads back into buffer, and deletes a temporary file for interactive editing.
